economic_hypothesis: After a material twenty-session decline, an intraday break of the prior five-session low followed by a completed high-turnover close above the prior session high and in the upper thirty percent of the range is evidence that urgent supply was absorbed. Unlike the prior panic-gap family, the forced sale may occur intraday and no opening-gap condition is used.

signal.universe: PIT hard-valid, fully tradable, non-ST Main Board and ChiNext common shares
signal.history: The preceding 20 market sessions are contiguous, current-valid and tradable in one corporate-action coordinate lineage.
signal.undercut: Signal-session coordinate low <= the minimum coordinate low of the preceding five completed sessions.
signal.participation: Signal-session turnover fraction >= the preceding twenty-session mean.
signal.full_absorption: Signal-session coordinate close >= the preceding session coordinate high and close location >=70%.
signal.limit_exclusion: Signal session does not close at its legal upper price limit.
signal.cooldown: Retain the first qualifying event per symbol; the next event must be more than 20 market-session indices later.

explicit_difference_from_prior_family.reason: This tests intraday forced-sale absorption, not a neighboring gap threshold.

chart_review.window: 126 market sessions before and 126 after the signal where available
chart_review.coordinate: accepted corporate-action-aware coordinate normalized to signal close 100

execution.entry: first legal executable daily open strictly after the signal, no later than the third subsequent market session
execution.target: +10% from executable entry, eligible from the first T+1 sellable session
execution.time_stop: after 20 completed market-session indices, exit at the next legal sellable open

development_gate.period: 2014-01-01 through 2021-12-31 after rules are frozen from 2014-2020 charts

outcome_governance.2021: held out from signal-chart rule formation; used once for frozen-rule development confirmation
outcome_governance.2022_2023: previously consumed elsewhere; challenge only, never independent OOS
